slice: Governance register-event recovery before mutable Documents access
finding: record_supported_event opened a Documents session and checked live metadata before the preliminary committed receipt lookup for register-required events. A historical committed result could become unavailable after document removal or a dependency failure.
change: Move the existing verified-session/owner/prepare-replay transaction before Documents session/list access for the same three existing register-required kinds/phases. Close its company guard before fresh external evidence I/O. Preserve final replay, current evidence assertions, Ledger transaction, other phases and original immutable result.

checks.scope: Pure/application tests with explicit persistence and external-session doubles; no live SQL/RLS/HTTP/browser proof from this check.

scenarios: Committed recovery for cash registered and loss-reduction registered/first-recognized events after document removal, absence or unavailable Documents session; no Documents/RF access or new effects.
Current owner revocation and a persisted receipt conflict still propagate before any Documents access.
Fresh misses still reject missing/removed corporate documents before RF verification or Ledger effects; existing final transaction and interposed replay regressions also pass.
limits: The workflow relies on the public prepare contract to authorize and bind stored recovery; separately staged SQL replay hardening needs actual database verification.

This change does not add evidence-amendment persistence, original-byte/economic final-SQL parity, Archive completeness policy or writer activation. All A1-A7 and complete release gates remain pending.

review.result: No material source findings: existing committed replay precedes Documents access; fresh-event checks remain. This review does not establish SQL/RLS/runtime proof.
